blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI-Native video creation is shifting from isolated video clips toward iterative video creation workflows. However, existing datasets remain largely video clips, representing video generation and editing as separate tasks rather than connected stages of a video creation workflow. In this paper, we introduce Sora100K, a dataset that represents the AI-Native video creation workflow as a structured video creation trajectory. Specifically, we first identify video creation trajectories and decompose them into three subsets according to their structural roles: text-to-video generation records as roots, single-turn video editing records as editing edges, and multi-turn video editing records as complete trajectories. Then, we use a VLM to assign semantic annotations for generation roots and editing-operation annotations for editing edges. A strict construction pipeline further reconstructs source-to-edit lineage, editing order, and intermediate video states while ensuring data quality. Finally, we perform lightweight adaptation on LTX-2 models to assess the supervision value of Sora100K. The results show improvements in visual quality, multi-shot generation, and cross-shot consistency, while successive-turn evaluation reveals that following multi-turn editing instructions remains challenging. Sora100K establishes a new data foundation for AI-Native video creation beyond isolated video clips and toward structured video creation trajectory. The dataset and supplementary materials are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ysicong/Sora100K.
blocks.zh: AI-Native视频创作正从孤立的视频剪辑转向迭代视频创作工作流程. 但是,现有的数据集基本上仍然是视频剪辑,代表视频生成和编辑是视频创建工作流程中单独的任务,而不是连接的阶段. 在本文中,我们引入了Sora100K,一个代表AI-Native视频创作工作流程的数据集,作为结构化视频创作轨迹. 具体而言,我们首先确定视频创作轨迹,并根据其结构作用将其分解为三个子集:文本到视频生成记录为根,单回合视频编辑记录为编辑边缘,多回合视频编辑记录为完整轨迹. 然后,我们用一个VLM来分配生成根的语义说明和编辑边缘的编辑操作说明. 严格的施工管道在确保数据质量的同时,进一步重建了源到编辑线条,编辑顺序和中间视频状态. 最后,我们对LTX-2型号进行轻量级改造,以评估Sora100K的监理价值. 结果显示视觉质量、多镜头生成和交叉镜头一致性都有所改善,而连续的回合评价显示,遵循多回合编辑指示仍然具有挑战性。 Sora100K为AI-Native视频的创作建立了新的数据基础,超越了孤立的视频片段,走向结构化的视频创作轨迹. 数据集和补充材料可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/ysicong/Sora100K上公开查阅。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Commercial video generation models ( OpenAI 2024 ; Google 2025 ; Runway 2025 ; Kling AI 2026 ; Seedance et al. 2026 ) continue to advance beyond short, isolated video clips toward cinematic videos with multi-shot structure and audio-visual synchronization. These advances are also changing how users create videos. Instead of relying on a single generation or editing step, users increasingly refine video content, visual style, camera motion, and audio through successive natural-language editing instructions. As illustrated in Figure 1 , we represent this workflow from the initial prompt to the final edited video as a video creation trajectory . It connects the initial generation with successive editing operations and intermediate video states.
blocks.zh: 商业视频生成模型(OpenAI 2024;Google 2025;Runway 2025;Kling AI 2026;Seedance等2026)继续超越短片,孤立视频片段向具有多镜头结构和视听同步的影视视频发展. 这些进步也正在改变用户创建视频的方式. 用户不再依赖单一的一代或编辑步骤,而是通过相继的自然语言编辑指令来不断完善视频内容,视觉风格,相机动作和音频. 如图1所示,我们从最初的提示到最后的被编辑的视频作为视频创作轨迹来代表这一工作流程。 它将初始生成与相继的编辑操作和中间视频状态相接.

blocks.en: However, as illustrated in Table 1 , existing open academic datasets remained largely video clips. Text-to-video datasets ( Wang et al. 2025 ; Chen et al. 2024 ) stored independent text–video pairs, while editing datasets ( Qin et al. 2024 ; Zi et al. 2025 ) stored single-step source–instruction–target triplets. This organization disconnected initial generation from successive edits and omitted editing order and intermediate video states. The key gap therefore lies not only in scale, but also in data representation: isolated video clips do not capture connected video creation trajectory.
blocks.zh: 然而,如表1所示,现有的开放式学术数据集基本上仍然是录像片段。 文本到视频数据集(Wang等. 2025; Chen等 2024)存储了独立的文本–video对,同时编辑了数据集(秦等. 2024; Zi等 2025)存储了单步源-指令-目标三相. 这个组织从相继编辑中断开初始生成,并省略了编辑顺序和中间视频状态. 因此,关键差距不仅在于规模,而且在于数据表述:孤立的视频片段不能捕捉相通的视频创建轨迹.

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce Sora100K, a large-scale dataset for video creation trajectory. As illustrated in Figure 1 , it contains over 100K video records curated from the AI-Native social media platform Sora2 ( OpenAI 2024 ) and organized into three structural subsets: text-to-video generation as generation roots, single-turn video editing as editing edges, and multi-turn video editing as complete video creation trajectories. These subsets jointly cover different stages of video creation trajectories. Beyond its trajectory-level organization, the proposed Sora100K explicitly preserves two properties that remain underexplored in open academic datasets, i.e. , multi-shot structure and audio-visual synchronization. These characteristics make Sora100K closer to contemporary real-world video creation workflow. To make our dataset analyzable and reusable, we develop an annotation pipeline. We use Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al. 2025 ) to scale the annotation of generation semantics and editing operations, these annotations provide structured information at the three subsets. We use manual inspection to verify the accuracy of the automated annotations. To evaluate the practical utility of Sora100K, we further apply lightweight LoRA ( Hu et al. 2022 ) adaptation to LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al. 2026 ) . The experimental results show that a small subset of Sora100K already provides effective supervision for video generation and editing.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了Sora100K,一个用于视频创作轨迹的大型数据集. 如图一所示,它包含由AI-Native社交媒体平台Sora2(OpenAI 2024)整理的超过100K视频记录,并被组织为三个结构子集:以文本到视频生成为生成根,以单回合视频编辑为编辑边缘,以多回合视频编辑为完整视频生成轨迹. 这些子集共同覆盖了视频创作轨迹的不同阶段. 在其轨迹级组织之外,所拟议的"Sora100K"明确保留了两个在开放的学术数据集中仍然未得到充分探索的属性,即多镜头结构和视听同步. 这些特性使"Sora100K"更接近于当代现实世界的视频创作工作流程. 为了使我们的数据集可以分析并重新使用,我们开发了一个注释管道。 我们使用Quen2.5-VL-7B(Bai等2025年)来扩大生成语义和编辑操作的注释,这些注释提供了三个子集的结构化信息. 我们用人工检查来验证自动说明的准确性. 为了评价Sora100K的实际用途,我们进一步将轻量级LORA(Hu等2022年)适应LTX-2(HaCohen等2026年). 实验结果表明,Sora100K的一个小子集已经为视频生成和编辑提供了有效的监督.

In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • We introduce a representation that structures AI-Native video creation as a creation trajectory with generation roots and editing edges. • We construct Sora100K, a large-scale dataset with semantic and editing annotations, source-to-edit lineage, intermediate video states, multi-shot structure, and audio-visual synchronization. • We provide structured annotations and trajectory-level organization that support
research on cross-turn dependencies, and maybe can support long-horizon video generation and editing in future research.

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 相关工作

blocks.en: Text-to-Video Generation Models and Datasets.
blocks.zh: 文本到视频生成模型和数据集.

blocks.en: Early video generation methods ( Vondrick et al. 2016 ; Tulyakov et al. 2018 ) , including GAN-based and autoregressive approaches, mainly focused on unconditional or weakly conditioned generation, limiting alignment with complex text prompts. Diffusion-based models later improved text–video alignment through text encoders and large-scale text–image pretraining. Early video diffusion models ( Ho et al. 2022 ; Singer et al. 2023 ) still struggled with temporal consistency, while later latent diffusion and spatiotemporal transformer architectures improved visual quality and temporal coherence. Recent models ( Seedance et al. 2026 ; Kling AI 2026 ) further supported structured multi-shot generation and audio-visual synchronization.
blocks.zh: 早期的视频生成方法(Vondrick等. 2016; Tulyakov等 2018 ),包括基于GAN和自相递减的方法,主要侧重于无条件或条件薄弱的生成,限制了与复杂文本提示的对接. 基于传播的模型后来通过文本编码器和大规模文本-图像预训改进了文本-视频对齐. 早期的视频传播模型(Ho等. 2022; Singer等 2023)仍然在时间一致性上挣扎,而后期的潜在扩散和瞬间变压器架构提高了视觉质量和时间一致性. 近期型号(原始内容等). 2026; Kling AI 2026 )进一步支持结构化多镜头生成和视听同步.

blocks.en: Large-scale datasets such as WebVid-10M ( Bain et al. 2021 ) and HD-VILA-100M ( Xue et al. 2022 ) provided the text–video pairs required to train foundational text-to-video models. Other datasets, including MSR-VTT ( Xu et al. 2016 ) and ActivityNet ( Caba Heilbron et al. 2015 ) , were widely used for video understanding, captioning, and retrieval. These datasets generally organized samples as independent text–video pairs. In our workflow-centric representation, each pair corresponds to a generation root that can support subsequent editing operations. However, prior datasets did not connect generation roots with later editing edges and therefore did not preserve source-to-edit lineage, editing order, or intermediate video states.
blocks.zh: 大型数据集如WebVid-10M(Bain等2021年)和HD-VILA-100M(Xue等2022年)提供了训练基础文本到视频模型所需的文本-video对. 其他数据集,包括MSR-VTT(徐等2016年)和ActiveNet(Caba Heilbron等2015年)被广泛用于视频理解,字幕和检索. 这些数据集一般将样本组织成独立的文本-视频对. 在以工作流程为中心的代表中,每对对应一个能支持后续编辑操作的一代根. 然而,之前的数据集并没有将生成根与后期编辑边缘相接,因此没有保留出自到编辑的线条,编辑顺序,或中间视频状态.

blocks.en: Video Editing Models and Datasets.
blocks.zh: 视频编辑模型与数据集.

blocks.en: Instruction-driven visual editing first advanced in the image domain. InstructPix2Pix ( Brooks et al. 2023 ) used model-generated paired data to learn general editing instructions. Extending this setting to video required temporal consistency across frames. Tune-A-Video ( Wu et al. 2023 ) and FateZero ( Qi et al. 2023 ) used one-shot tuning or attention mechanisms to preserve source structure, while TokenFlow ( Geyer et al. 2023 ) and CoDeF ( Ouyang et al. 2023 ) modeled temporal correspondences for consistent editing. These methods mainly addressed individual editing operations, which correspond to editing edges in a video creation trajectory. Recent studies explored iterative editing and cross-turn consistency ( Lee et al. 2026 ) , but data preserving successive prompts and videos remained limited.
blocks.zh: 指令驱动的视觉编辑首先在图像领域被推进. 指令Pix2Pix(Brooks等2023年)使用模型生成的配对数据来学习一般编辑指令. 将这个设置扩展至视频需要跨帧的时间一致性 。 Tune-A-Video (Wu等 2023年)和FateZero (Qi等 2023年)使用一发调取或注意机制来维护源结构,而TokenFlow (Geyer等 2023年)和CoDeF (Oyang等 2023年)则以时间通信为模型来进行一致的编辑. 这些方法主要针对个人编辑操作,这与视频创作轨迹中的编辑边缘相对应. 最近的研究探索了迭代编辑和倒转一致性(Lee等2026年),但保存相继的提示和视频的数据仍然有限.

blocks.en: Recent datasets expanded the scale and coverage of instruction-based video editing. InstructVid2Vid ( Qin et al. 2024 ) constructed video–instruction triplets for general editing, while VIVID-10M ( Hu et al. 2024 ) focused on large-scale local editing. Señorita-2M ( Zi et al. 2025 ) and OpenVE-3M ( He et al. 2025 ) further improved data quality and editing diversity. However, these datasets generally stored each operation as an independent source–instruction–target triplet. Such triplets provide supervision for individual editing edges but do not connect them to the generation root or preserve editing order and intermediate states.
blocks.zh: 最近的数据集扩大了基于教学的视频编辑的规模和覆盖面. 指令Vid2Vid (秦等2024年)为一般编辑而构建的视频-指令三重奏;而VIVID-10M (胡等2024年)则以大规模本地编辑为主. Señorita-2M(Zi等人,2025年)和OpenVE-3M(他等人,2025年)进一步提高了数据质量和编辑多样性. 然而,这些数据集一般将每个操作作为一个独立的源-指令-目标三进制存储. 此类三重奏为单个编辑边缘提供监督,但不连接到生成根上,也不保留编辑顺序和中间状态.

As shown in Table 1 and Figure 2 , Sora100K represents AI-Native video creation as a structured creation trajectory that connects the video generation, video editing and creation trajectory, Sora100K moves beyond isolated video clips by modeling creation trajectories and retaining multi-shot and audio-visual information.

blocks.en: Video-Level Characteristics
blocks.zh: 视频级特征

blocks.en: Sora100K exhibits two properties: audio-visual synchronization and multi-shot structure, which were weakly supported in prior video generation and editing datasets.
blocks.zh: Sora100K展出两个属性:视听同步和多相机结构,在之前的视频生成和编辑数据集中都得到了微弱的支持.

blocks.en:
Audio-Visual Synchronization .
Sora100K preserves audio signals that are closely aligned with the visual content. Earlier video datasets often contained visual-only samples because of the limited audio-generation capabilities of previous models, restricting their use for joint audio-visual modeling. In contrast, Sora100K retains the original synchronized audio without excessive processing, providing a practical data foundation for audio-visual video generation.
blocks.zh:
视听同步.
Sora100K保存了与视觉内容紧密相通的音频信号. 更早的视频数据集往往包含只可视化的样本,因为前作模型的音频生成能力有限,限制了它们用于联合视听模型. 相形之下,Sora100K保留了原来的同步音频而无需过度处理,为视听视频生成提供了实用的数据基础.

blocks.en:
Multi-Shot Structure .
Sora100K contains a large proportion of videos with clear multi-shot organization. Earlier datasets were largely dominated by single-shot clips and provided limited scene transitions and shot changes. Although the Sora2 technical report did not explicitly emphasize multi-shot generation, our analysis shows that most collected videos contain multiple shots and generally maintain character consistency across shot transitions.
blocks.zh:
多热结构.
Sora100K包含一大部分具有清晰多镜头组织的视频. 早期的数据集主要以一发相片片片段为主,提供有限的场景过渡和镜头变化. 虽然"索拉2"技术报告没有明确强调多镜头生成,但我们的分析显示,所收集的视频大多包含多镜头并总体上保持了镜头过渡的性能一致性.

blocks.en: Dataset Construction and Annotation
blocks.zh: 数据集构建与注释

blocks.en: In this section, we describe how Sora100K is constructed, how its three subsets are annotated, and how each subset is composed within a unified and systematic framework. As illustrated in Figure 11 , we present representative samples here and provide additional examples in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述了Sora100K的构造方式,其三个子集是如何被附加说明的,以及每个子集是如何在一个统一而系统的框架内构成的. 如图11所示,我们在此提出有代表性的样本,并在附录中提供其他例子。

blocks.en: Data Curation and Quality Filtering
blocks.zh: 数据校正和质量过滤

blocks.en:
We construct Sora100K from approximately 180K public Sora2 ( OpenAI 2024 ) records. After recovering prompts, editing instructions, and available source references, we apply accessibility, VBench-based quality, and traceability filtering, retaining approximately 137K, 111K, and finally 103.4K records.
We organize the filtered records according to their recovered source-to-edit relations. Every valid initial generation is retained as a root in the text-to-video generation subset, even when no subsequent edit is available. Every valid source–instruction–target relation is retained as an edge in the single-turn video editing subset. Records containing only one edit therefore contribute both a generation root and an editing edge, while only connected paths with at least three video states are included in the multi-turn video editing subset. This process yields 18,451 generation roots, 76,964 editing edges, and 8,024 multi-turn trajectories.
And we inspect representative trajectories and find their source-to-edit lineage, editing order, and intermediate states to be consistent with the recovered metadata. We use Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al. 2025 ) to annotate root semantics and edge-level editing operations, and further verify the automatic annotations through human evaluation.
blocks.zh:
我们从大约180K公共Sora2(OpenAI 2024)记录中构建了Sora100K. 在恢复了提示,编辑指令,以及可用的源引用之后,我们应用了可访问性,基于V Bench的质量,以及可追溯性过滤,保留了大约137K,111K,最后103.4K记录.
我们根据它们恢复的源头对编辑的关系来组织过滤记录. 每个有效的初始生成被保留为文本到视频生成子集中的根,即使没有后续编辑可用. 每个有效的源 - 指令 - 目标关系都被保留为单回合视频编辑子集中的一个边缘. 因此,只包含一款编辑的记录既贡献了一代根又贡献了编辑边缘,而仅包含至少三个视频状态的连接路径则包含在多回合视频编辑子集中. 这个过程产生出18,451个生成根,76,964个编辑边,和8,024个多转轨.
我们检查具有代表性的轨迹,发现它们的源到编辑线条,编辑顺序,中间状态都与回收的元数据一致. 我们使用Quen2.5-VL-7B(Bai等,2025年)对根语义和边缘层编辑操作进行注释,并通过人文评价进一步验证自动注释.

blocks.en: Dataset Annotation
blocks.zh: 数据集注释

blocks.en: A video creation trajectory contains information at different structural levels. We therefore adopt a hierarchical annotation scheme over the text-to-video generation, single-turn video editing, and multi-turn video editing subsets. These annotations characterize the generation roots, editing operations, and the video creation trajectories, respectively.
blocks.zh: 视频创作轨迹包含不同结构层次的信息. 因此,我们对文本到视频生成、单回合视频编辑和多回合视频编辑子集采取了分级注释办法。 这些说明分别描述出生成根,编辑操作,和视频生成轨迹.

blocks.en: Root-Level Semantic Annotation. For the text-to-video generation subset, we characterize each generation root along five dimensions: semantic category, video duration, frame count, number of shots, and prompt length. We construct a single-label semantic taxonomy, and use Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al. 2025 ) to annotate the samples. Prompt length is extracted from the original metadata, while the video-level attributes are obtained through video analysis.
blocks.zh: 根层语义注释. 对于从文本到视频生成子集,我们按照五个维度来描述每一代根:语义分类,视频持续时间,帧数,镜头数,以及即时长度. 我们构建一个单一标签的语义分类法,并使用Quen2.5-VL-7B(Bai等人,2025年)对样品进行注释。 从原始元数据中提取出快速长度,而视频级别属性则通过视频分析获得.

blocks.en: Edge-Level Operation Annotation. For the single-turn video editing subset, we characterize each editing edge by its editing category, video duration, frame count, and number of shots. We construct a multi-label taxonomy because one edited may involve multi-modifications. We use Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al. 2025 ) to annotate the samples.
blocks.zh: 边缘级行动说明. 对于单回合视频编辑子集,我们按其编辑类别、视频持续时间、帧数和镜头数来描述每个编辑边缘。 我们构建一个多标签分类法,因为一个经过编辑的分类法可能涉及多修改。 我们使用Quen2.5-VL-7B(Bai等人,2025年)对样品进行注释。

blocks.en: Trajectory-Level Structural Annotation. For the multi-turn video editing subset, we preserve the editing category, source-to-edit lineage, and chain length of each video creation trajectory. These structural annotations connect the generation roots and editing edges into ordered creation trajectory and support the analysis of multi-turn dependencies. This structural information connects the annotated generation roots and editing edges into complete trajectories.
blocks.zh: 轨迹-水平结构注释. 对于多回合视频编辑子集,我们保留每个视频创建轨迹的编辑类别,出自到编辑的分行和链长. 这些结构说明将生成根和编辑边缘连接到有秩序的生成轨迹中,并支持对多回合依赖性的分析. 这种结构信息将注释生成根和编辑边缘连接成完整的轨迹.

blocks.en: Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: 数据集统计

blocks.en: We first examine the multi-turn video editing subset to characterize the trajectory-level structure of Sora100K, and followed by the generation roots and editing edges. The detailed distributions are shown in Figure 4 . We present further statistical details and sample illustrations in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查多回合视频编辑子集,以描述Sora100K的轨迹级结构,然后是生成根和编辑边缘. 详细分布情况见图4。 我们在附录中进一步提供了统计细节和示例。

blocks.en: Trajectory-Level Structural Statistics. Sora100K has 8,024 multi-turn video editing trajectories, accounting for 7.8% of its 103.4K structured records. As shown in Figure 4 , we analyze editing-operation types rather than initial-generation semantics. Object-level operations account for the largest proportion at 4.38%, followed by style-level (1.83%), plot-level (0.65%), scene-level (0.50%), and other operations (0.44%) of the full dataset.
blocks.zh: 轨迹-层次结构统计. Sora100K拥有8,024个多回合视频编辑轨迹,占其103.4K结构记录的7.8%. 如图4所示,我们分析的是编辑操作类型,而不是初代语义. 对象级操作占4.38%的最大比例,其次是风格级(1.83%),地块级(0.65%),场景级(0.50%),以及其他操作(0.44%).

blocks.en: We define chain length as the total number of video states in a trajectory, including the initial generation root and all subsequent edited states. Trajectories with 3, 4, and 5 states account for 61.5%, 18.4%, and 12.3%, respectively, while 7.8% contain more than 5 states. Thus, 92.2% of the trajectories represent compact iterative workflows with 3–5 states, whereas the remainder captures longer creation trajectory.
blocks.zh: 我们把链长定义为一个轨迹中的视频状态的总数,包括初始生成根和所有后来被编辑的状态. 3、4和5个州的轨迹分别占61.5%、18.4%和12.3%,7.8%的轨迹包含5个以上州。 因此,92.2%的轨迹代表有3至5个状态的紧凑迭接工作流程,而其余的轨迹则能捕捉更长的创造轨迹。

blocks.en: Root-Level Semantic Statistics. As shown in Figure 4 , generation roots account for 17.8% of all structured records. Within the generation subset, people-related content dominates at 13.68%, followed by animals (2.33%), transportation (0.49%), scenery (0.43%), and other categories (0.86%) of the full dataset, respectively. Since the initial generations in multi-turn trajectories exhibit a similar semantic distribution, we report only the aggregate generation statistics.
blocks.zh: 根层语义统计. 如图4所示,生成根占所有结构化记录的17.8%. 在一代子集中,与人有关的内容占13.68%,其次是动物(2.33%)、交通(0.49%)、景地(0.43%)和完整数据集的其他类别(0.86%)。 由于多转轨迹中最初的几代人表现出相近的语义分布,我们只报告总的生成统计.

blocks.en: Most videos are approximately 10 seconds long and contain around 300 frames at 30 FPS, while approximately 65.5% exhibit a multi-shot structure. For prompt length, 52.2% contain no more than 10 words, followed by 16.6% with 11–25 words, 10.3% with 26–50 words, 10.7% with 51–100 words, and 10.3% with more than 100 words.
blocks.zh: 大多数视频长约10秒,包含30个FPS的约300帧,而约65.5%显示多镜头结构. 就快速长度而言,52.2%的字数不超过10个字,其次是16.6%有11-25个字,10.3%有26-50个字,10.7%有51-100个字,10.3%有100个字以上。

blocks.en: Edge-Level Operation Statistics. Within the single-turn editing subset, object-level operations account for 38.68%, followed by style-level (20.09%), scene-level (6.70%), narrative and temporal (3.72%), and other operations (5.21%) of the full dataset, respectively. Generation roots and editing edges provide the initial states and state transitions that compose creation trajectories. Because the video-level attributes of the single-turn and multi-turn editing subsets closely match those of the generation subset, we omit their duplicate distributions.
blocks.zh: 边际行动统计。 在单回合编辑子集中,对象级操作占38.68%,其次是样式级(20.09%),场景级(6.70%),叙事和时间级(3.72%),以及其他操作(5.21%),分别占完整数据集的比重. 生成根和编辑边提供了最初的状态和状态过渡来构成创建轨迹. 由于单回转和多回转编辑子集的视频级属性与生成子集的属性紧密相匹配,我们省略了它们的重复发行.

blocks.en: Natural Distribution and Annotation Reliability
blocks.zh: 自然分布和注释可靠性

blocks.en: The distributions in Sora100K are naturally imbalanced, with people-related generation samples and several common editing operations accounting for relatively large proportions. Rather than constructing a conventionally balanced benchmark, Sora100K preserves the natural creation processes observed on an AI-Native video platform ( OpenAI 2024 ) . The semantic categories of generation roots and editing operations of edges therefore reflect the creation intents observed during initial generation and successive refinement. We retain the corresponding annotations and metadata, allowing researchers to resample the data or construct balanced subsets for specific downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: Sora100K的分布自然是不平衡的,与人有关的一代样本和几种常见的编辑操作占了相对较大的比例. Sora100K没有构建一个常规均衡的基准,而是保留了AI-Native视频平台(OpenAI 2024)所观察到的自然创造过程. 因此,生成根的语义分类和边缘的编辑操作反映了在初始生成和相继完善过程中观察到的生成意图. 我们保留了相应的说明和元数据,使研究人员能够重新取出数据或为具体的下游任务构建平衡子集.

blocks.en: To assess the reliability of the VLM-based annotations used to characterize creation trajectories, we randomly sample generation roots and editing edges and compare the labels produced by Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al. 2025 ) with human annotations under the same taxonomies. The automatic annotations achieve an accuracy of 98.19%, a Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.959, and a weighted F1 score of 98.26%. These results support the reliability of the semantic and editing-operation annotations used to characterize creation trajectories.
blocks.zh: 为了评估用于描述创建轨迹的以VLM为基础的说明的可靠性,我们随机抽取了生成根和编辑边并比较了由Qun2.5-VL-7B(Bai等2025年)生产的标签与同一分类法下的人类说明. 自动说明的精度达到98.19%,科恩的克普克0.959分,加权F1分98.26%. 这些结果支持了用于描述创建轨迹的语义和编辑操作说明的可靠性.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Qualitative comparison on trajectory-level video editing. The Sora100K-adapted pipeline produces higher aesthetic quality while maintaining comparable subject consistency across successive editing turns.
blocks.zh: 图5:轨迹级视频编辑定性比较. Sora100K自适应管线生产出更高的审美质量,同时在相继的编辑回合中保持可比的主题一致性.

blocks.en: Experiment
blocks.zh: 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate whether Sora100K provides effective supervision for trajectory-level video creation. Because current open-source models do not support direct training on complete multimodal trajectories, we adapt separate generation and editing components using trajectory roots and edges, then recombine them for successive-turn evaluation. We also evaluate each component independently to identify the sources of performance gains.
blocks.zh: 我们评价Sora100K是否为轨迹级的视频创建提供有效的监督. 由于目前的开源模型不支持对完整的多模式轨迹进行直接培训,因此我们利用轨迹根和边缘来调整单独的生成和编辑组件,然后把它们重新压缩,进行相继的回合评价. 我们还独立评估每个组成部分,以确定业绩收益的来源。

blocks.en: Experiment Setting
blocks.zh: 实验设置

blocks.en: We construct an iterative pipeline with LTX-2-T2AV ( HaCohen et al. 2026 ) as the generator and LTX-2-T2AV-IC ( HaCohen et al. 2026 ) as the editor. Using LoRA ( Hu et al. 2022 ) , we adapt the generator on 3,000 generation roots and the editor on 3,000 editing edges. During evaluation, the generator produces the initial video from the root prompt, and the editor then applies the original instructions sequentially, using each output as the input to the next turn. We evaluate every resulting video state and compare the original and Sora100K-adapted pipelines. Detailed settings and more experiment samples are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 我们建造了以LTX-2-T2AV(HaCohen等2026年)为发电机并用LTX-2-T2AV-IC(HaCohen等2026年)为编辑器的迭接管. 使用LORA(Hu等2022年), 在评价期间,生成器从根快取出初始视频,然后由编辑器相继应用原始指令,将每个输出作为输入到下个转弯. 我们评价了所有产生的视频状态,并比较了原始和Sora100K改造的管道。 附录中提供了详细的设置和更多的实验样本.

blocks.en: Table 2: Multi-turn video editing results over two successive editing turns. S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} is a reference-based VLM score using the ground-truth edited video, while S Sub S_{\mathrm{Sub}} and S Aes S_{\mathrm{Aes}} are computed with VBench.
blocks.zh: 表2:多回合视频编辑结果通过连续两个编辑回合. Seff S_{\mathrm{eff}是使用地上真实编辑的视频制作的基于参考的VLM分数,而S Sub S_{\mathrm{Sub}}和S Aes S_{\mathrm{Aes}}用V Bench来计算.

blocks.en: Experiment Results
blocks.zh: 实验结果

blocks.en: Trajectory-Level Video Creation Results. As shown in Figure 5 , we create a trajectory, and we evaluate each edited state using a VLM-based evaluator ( Bai et al. 2025 ) for editing effectiveness ( S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} ), subject consistency ( S Sub S_{\mathrm{Sub}} ), and aesthetic quality ( S Aes S_{\mathrm{Aes}} ), with their mean reported as the overall score. Table 2 shows that both pipelines degrade across turns. However, the Sora100K-adapted pipeline performs better, achieving a higher two-turn average of 62.4 versus 60.6.
blocks.zh: 轨迹-水平视频创建结果. 如图5所示,我们创建了轨迹,我们使用一个基于VLM的评价器(Bai等人,2025年)来评价每个编辑状态,以达到编辑效果(Seff S_{\mathrm{eff}}),主题一致性(S Sub s_{\mathrm{Sub}}),美学质量(S Aes S_{\mathrm{Aes}}),其平均值报告为总分. 表2显示,两条输油管呈倒转式降解。 然而,Sora100K改造后输油管的性能较好,实现了62.4比60.6.

blocks.en: The improvement primarily comes from aesthetic quality, whose two-turn average increases from 41.5 to 46.9. Subject consistency remains comparable, while editing effectiveness has the same two-turn average of 43.0 for both pipelines. These results show that Sora100K supervision improves the visual quality of video states throughout iterative creation, although successive editing remains challenging as errors accumulate across turns.
blocks.zh: 改善主要来自美学质量,美学质量的两回平均从41.5提高到46.9. 主题一致性仍可比较,而编辑效果与两条管线的两回合平均为43.0. 这些结果显示"Sora100K"监督在整个迭代创作过程中提高了视频状态的视觉质量,尽管随着错误的累积,相继的编辑仍然具有挑战性.

blocks.en: But the trajectory pipeline combines separate generation and editing models, the trajectory-level gains do not directly reveal which component benefits most from Sora100K supervision. We therefore conduct two controlled experiments that isolate the generation and editing stages, respectively, to identify the primary source of improvement.
blocks.zh: 但轨迹管道结合了单独的生成和编辑模型,轨迹水平收益并不直接揭示出哪些组件从"Sora100K"监督中受益最大. 因此,我们进行了两次分别隔离生成和编辑阶段的控制试验,以确定主要的改进来源。

blocks.en: Root-Level Video Generation Experiments. We compare the original LTX-2 generator with models adapted on Panda-70M ( Chen et al. 2024 ) and Sora100K using the same 200 held-out prompts. As shown in Table 3 , Sora100K achieves the best overall score of 76.43 and leads on five of the six metrics. Compared with the original model, it improves aesthetic quality from 59.11 to 62.98, imaging quality from 47.84 to 57.22, and ArcFace ( Deng et al. 2019 ) from 48.30 to 59.70. The substantial ArcFace gain indicates stronger identity consistency across shots, while motion smoothness remains nearly unchanged. Figure 6 further shows that the Sora100K-adapted model produces cleaner structures and more consistent subjects across shots. These results confirm that generation-root supervision provides a stronger initial state for trajectory construction.
blocks.zh: 根层视频生成实验. 我们使用同样的200个被搁置的提示器,将最初的LTX-2发电机与Panda-70M(Chen等2024年)和Sora100K上所改编的模型进行比较。 如表3所显示,"Sora100K"取得了76.43的最好总分并领先于6个公分中5个. 与原型相比,它提高了美学质量,从59.11到62.98,成像质量从47.84到57.22,ArcFace(Deng等2019)从48.30到59.70. 巨大的ArcFace增益表明,各镜头的特性更加一致,而运动平滑度几乎保持不变。 图6还显示,Sora100K适应型号可产生更清洁的结构,并在整个镜头中产生更一致的主题. 这些结果证实,世代制监督为轨迹建造提供了更强大的初始状态.

blocks.en: Edge-Level Video Editing Experiments. We next evaluate whether Sora100K improves individual state transitions along a trajectory. A VLM-based evaluator ( Bai et al. 2025 ) measures instruction following ( S inst S_{\mathrm{inst}} ), editing effectiveness ( S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} ), subject consistency ( S Sub S_{\mathrm{Sub}} ), and aesthetic quality ( S Aes S_{\mathrm{Aes}} ). As shown in Table 4 , adaptation improves S inst S_{\mathrm{inst}} from 43.4 to 47.9, S eff S_{\mathrm{eff}} from 38.7 to 44.2, and S Aes S_{\mathrm{Aes}} from 49.8 to 53.8, increasing the average score from 56.0 to 59.4. Subject consistency remains nearly unchanged, decreasing slightly from 92.0 to 91.7. Figure 7 shows corresponding improvements in editing strength and visual quality. These results demonstrate that editing-edge supervision improves the transitions between successive video states.
blocks.zh: 边缘视频编辑实验. 接下来我们评估Sora100K是否在轨迹上改进了个别州的过渡. 一个基于VLM的评价师(Bai等人,2025年)的测量指令遵循(Sint S_{\mathrm{inst}}),编辑效果(Seff S_{\mathrm{eff}}),主题一致性(S Sub S_{\mathrm{Sub}}),美学质量(S Aes S_{\mathrm{Aes}}). 如表4所示,适应改进了Sint S_{\mathrm{inst}}从43.4到47.9,Seff S_{\mathrm{eff}}从38.7到44.2,Ses S_{\mathrm{Aes}}从49.8到53.8,使平均分从56.0到59.4. 主题一致性几乎保持不变,从92.0略降至91.7。 图7显示了编辑强度和视觉质量的相应改善. 这些结果显示,编辑前沿监督可以改善相继相继的视频状态之间的过渡.

blocks.en: Generation roots improve the initial state, while editing edges strengthen subsequent transitions; however, performance still declines across turns.
blocks.zh: 生成根会改善初始状态,而编辑边缘则会加强后期的过渡;然而,跨转弯的性能仍然下降.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Sora100K, a dataset that extends video data from isolated clips to structured audio-visual creation trajectories. It represents text-to-video generation, single-turn video editing, and multi-turn video editing subsets as roots, editing edges, and complete trajectories, while preserving source-to-edit lineage, intermediate video states. It also retains multi-shot structure and synchronized audio, more faithfully capturing key properties of modern AI-generated videos. Sora100K is constructed through systematic filtering, workflow reconstruction, structured annotation, and human validation, providing a curated resource for studying AI-Native video creation. Experiment results show that Sora100K provides effective supervision for video generation and single-turn editing, thereby enhancing performance in areas such as visual quality, cross-shot consistency, editing effectiveness and stronger instruction following.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Sora100K,一个数据集,将视频数据从相隔片段延伸至结构化的视听创作轨迹. 它代表了文本到视频生成,单翻视频编辑,多翻视频编辑子集作为词根,编辑边缘,以及完整的轨迹,同时保留了源到编辑行,中间视频状态. 它还保留了多镜头结构和同步音频,更忠实地捕捉了现代AI出品视频的关键属性. Sora100K是通过系统过滤,工作流程重建,结构化注释,以及人类验证来构建的,为研究AI-Native视频创建提供了被整理的资源. 实验结果显示"Sora100K"为视频生成和单回合编辑提供了有效的监督,从而提高了视觉质量,交叉镜头一致性,编辑效果等领域的性能并强化了后续指令.

blocks.en:

First, suitable open-source models remain limited; many ( Team et al. 2026 ; Zhang et al. 2026 ) are derived from LTX-2 or incompatible with our input modalities. Second, creation trajectories remain beyond the capabilities of most open-source models, those are close-source.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 8 – Figure 9 , we present a comparison of the proposed dataset with existing representative video datasets. Existing public datasets for video generation and editing remain primarily organized around clip-level, no-audio video samples, offering very limited explicit support for multi-shot structures and audio-visual video creation. Consequently, these datasets are currently insufficient for investigating long-range temporal consistency, cross-shot composition, and audiovisual coherence.
blocks.zh: 如图8-图9所示,我们提出了拟议数据集同现有有代表性的视频数据集的比较。 现有的用于视频生成和编辑的公共数据集仍然主要围绕剪辑层面的无声视频样本进行编排,对多镜头结构和视听视频制作的明确支持非常有限. 因此,这些数据集目前不足以调查长期时间一致性、交叉镜头组成和视听一致性。

blocks.en: Compared to existing video generation and editing datasets, Sora100K stands out for its more systematic coverage of key attributes such as long-term content, multi-shot structures, and audio-visual synchronization. These attributes are more aligned with current trends in video generation and the creative needs of real users. Therefore, this not only enhances the dataset’s relevance to real-world scenarios but also provides a more supportive resource foundation for research on long-range dependency modeling, cross-shot organization, and audio-visual collaborative generation.
blocks.zh: 相较于现有的视频生成和编辑数据集,Sora100K以更系统地覆盖长期内容,多镜头结构,视听同步等关键属性而出名. 这些属性更符合目前视频生成的趋势和真实用户的创意需要. 因此,这不仅加强了数据集与现实世界情景的相关性,而且为远程依赖模型研究、跨镜头组织和视听协作生成提供了更有利的资源基础。

blocks.en:
In this section, we will present more samples from our dataset, with each sample displayed according to our classification categories.
For Text-to-Video Generation, we organize all samples into eight semantic categories: People , Animal , Plant , Food & Drink , Transportation , Scenery , Architecture , and Science & Tech .
Each generation video is assigned a primary label based on its main narrative theme.
Each samples as shown in Figure 10 – Figure 11 .
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们将提出更多来自我们数据集的样本,每个样本按照我们的分类类别显示.
对于文本到视频生成,我们将所有样本分为8个语义类别:人、动物、植物、食品和饮料、交通、摄取、建筑和科技。
每一代视频都根据其主要叙事主题被分配到一款主标签.
每个样本如图10-图11所示。

blocks.en: People. This category includes videos in which one or more human figures constitute the primary visual subject, covering portraits, social interactions, performances, sports, professional activities, and everyday behaviors. A video is assigned to this category when people remain the central focus, even if animals, vehicles, or environmental elements are also present. This category contains 14,169 samples.
blocks.zh: 众生. 这一类包括一个或几个人类人物构成主要视觉主题的视频,包括肖像,社会互动,表演,运动,专业活动,以及日常行为等. 当人们仍然是中心焦点时,即使动物、车辆或环境元素也存在,录像也被划入这一类别。 这一类别包括14 169个样本。

blocks.en: Animal. This category includes videos in which animals constitute the primary visual subject, including pets, wildlife, birds, insects, marine animals, and anthropomorphic animals. This category contains 2,417 samples.
blocks.zh: 动物。 这一类包括动物构成主要视觉主题的视频,包括宠物、野生动物、鸟类、昆虫、海洋动物和人类形态动物。 此类样本有2,417个。

blocks.en: Transportation. This category includes videos primarily depicting vehicles or transportation-related activities, such as cars, trains, aircraft, ships, bicycles, motorcycles, and other forms of transportation. This category contains 511 samples.
blocks.zh: 运输。 这一类包括主要描述车辆或与运输有关的活动的视频,如汽车、火车、飞机、船舶、自行车、摩托车等,以及其他形式的运输。 这一类别包括511个样本。

blocks.en: Scenery. This category includes videos primarily depicting natural environments or broad landscapes without a dominant human, animal, or human-made subject. Representative content includes mountains, forests, beaches, rivers, deserts, skies, and weather-related scenes. This category contains 446 samples.
blocks.zh: 斯摄取相. 这一类包括主要描绘自然环境或广阔地貌的视频,没有主导人类、动物或人造主体。 代表性内容包括山地,森林,海滩,河流,沙漠,天空等与天气有关的场景. 这一类别包括446个样本。

blocks.en: Food & Drink. This category includes videos centered on food, beverages,ingredients, cooking processes, food preparation, plating, or eating and drinking scenes. This category contains 380 samples.
blocks.zh: 食饮. 这一类包括以食物,饮料,食材,烹饪过程,食品制备,电镀等为主的视频,或以食饮场景为主. 这一类别包含380个样本。

blocks.en: Architecture. This category includes videos in which buildings or human-made spaces constitute the primary visual subject, including houses, palaces, temples, bridges, urban structures, interior spaces, and other architectural environments. This category contains 237 samples.
blocks.zh: 建筑学. 这一类包括建筑或人造空间构成主要视觉主题的视频,包括房屋,宫殿,庙宇,桥梁,城市结构,室内空间等建筑环境. 这一类别包括237个样本。

blocks.en: Science & Technology. This category includes videos primarily depicting scientific or technological subjects, such as robots, electronic devices, computer interfaces, laboratories, spacecraft, industrial equipment, and futuristic technologies. This category contains 234 samples.
blocks.zh: 科技报. 这一类包括主要描绘科技主题的视频,如机器人,电子设备,计算机接口,实验室,航天器,工业设备,以及未来技术等. 这一类别包括234个样本。

blocks.en: Plants. This category includes videos in which plants themselves constitute the primary visual subject, including flowers, trees, crops, potted plants, and plant-growth processes. Plants appearing only as part of a broader natural environment are instead categorized as Scenery . This category contains 44 samples.
blocks.zh: 植物。 植物。 这一类包括由植物本身构成主要视觉主题的视频,包括花卉、树木、作物、被盆栽和植物生长过程。 植物只是作为更广泛的自然环境的一部分出现的,而是被归类为草本植物。 这一类别包括44个样本。

blocks.en: Single-Turn Video Editing Subset
blocks.zh: 单调视频编辑子集

blocks.en: We further analyze the Single-Turn Video Editing subset along four dimensions: editing category, video duration, frame count, and number of shots. Based on the automatic annotations produced by Qwen2.5-VL, object-level editing accounts for the largest proportion at 52%, followed by style-level editing at 27%. Temporal and scene-level editing account for 9% and 5%, respectively, while the remaining 7% consists of operations that are not fully covered by the predefined taxonomy. These distributions show that Sora100K covers common video editing operations while retaining diverse and open-ended editing requests. Each samples as shown in Figure 12 .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步按照四个方面分析单调视频编辑子集:编辑类别、视频持续时间、帧数和镜头数。 根据Quen2.5-VL制作的自动说明,对象级编辑比例最大,为52%,其次是风格级编辑比例为27%. 时间和场景层面的编辑分别占9%和5%,而其余的7%则由未被预定义分类法完全覆盖的操作所组成. 这些发售显示"Sora100K"覆盖了常见的视频编辑业务,同时保留了多样和开放式的编辑请求. 图12所示的每个样本。

blocks.en: Object-Level Editing. This category includes localized modifications to foreground objects, people, animals, or other visible entities. Typical operations include adding, removing, replacing, duplicating, resizing, repositioning, recoloring, or modifying the attributes of an entity while largely preserving the surrounding environment and overall visual style. Object-level editing accounts for 52% of the Single-Turn Video Editing subset.
blocks.zh: 对象级编辑 。 这一类别包括对前景物体、人、动物或其他可见实体进行局部修改。 典型的操作包括添加,去除,替换,复制,再大小化,再定位,再涂色,或者修改一个实体的属性,同时基本保持周围环境和整体视觉风格. 对象级编辑占单调视频编辑子集的52%.

blocks.en: Style-Level Editing. This category includes modifications to the visual appearance of a video without fundamentally changing its primary subjects or scene structure. Typical operations include changing the artistic style, color palette, lighting, texture, rendering mode, or overall cinematic tone. Style-level editing accounts for 27% of the subset.
blocks.zh: 样式级编辑。 这一类包括修改视频的视觉外观,而不会从根本上改变其主体或场景结构. 典型的操作包括改变艺术风格,彩色调色板,照明,纹理,渲染模式,或整体的影音. 样式级编辑占子集的27%.

blocks.en: Temporal Editing. This category includes modifications to actions, motion dynamics, or the temporal organization of a video. Typical operations include changing an action, motion speed, movement direction, motion trajectory, event order, duration, or temporal continuity. Temporal editing accounts for 9% of the subset.
blocks.zh: 时间编辑。 这一类包括修改动作,运动动态,或视频的暂时组织. 典型的操作包括改变一个动作,运动速度,运动方向,运动轨迹,事件顺序,持续时间,或时间连续性. 时间编辑占子集的9%.

blocks.en: Scene-Level Editing. This category includes modifications to the broader environment or spatial composition of a video. Typical operations include changing the background, location, weather, time of day, scene layout, viewpoint, or camera framing while retaining the main subject when appropriate. Scene-level editing accounts for 5% of the subset.
blocks.zh: 场景级编辑. 这一类包括修改更广泛的环境或视频的空间构成。 典型的操作包括改变背景,位置,天气,白天时间,场景布局,视线,或相机相框,同时酌情保留主体. 场景级编辑占子集的5%.

blocks.en: Other Editing. This category includes uncommon, compound, or ambiguous editing operations that cannot be reliably assigned to the predefined object-, style-, temporal-, or scene-level categories. It also covers instructions that simultaneously modify multiple aspects without a clearly dominant editing intent. This category accounts for the remaining 7% of the subset.
blocks.zh: 其他编辑。 这一类包括不寻常的,复合的,或模棱两可的编辑操作,这些操作无法可靠地被分配到预定义的对象,样式,时间,或场景级别等类别. 它还涵盖了同时修改多个方面而没有明确主导编辑意图的指令. 这一类占子集的剩余7%.

blocks.en: Multi-Turn Video Editing Subset
blocks.zh: 多回合视频编辑子集

blocks.en: The Multi-Turn Video Editing subset captures iterative creation processes in which each trajectory starts from an initial generated video and evolves through multiple successive editing turns. Unlike the Single-Turn Video Editing subset, which represents individual source–instruction–target transitions, this subset preserves the ordered sequence of intermediate video states and editing instructions. Each samples as shown in Figure 13 .
blocks.zh: 多盘视频 编辑子集捕捉到迭代创建过程,其中每个轨迹都从一个初始生成的视频起步,并通过多个相接的编辑转折来演化. 与代表单个源-指令-目标转换的单调视频编辑子集不同,该子集保留了中间视频状态和编辑指令的顺序顺序. 图13所示的每个样本。

blocks.en: Appendix D Dataset Annotation and Statistics
blocks.zh: 附录D 数据集说明和统计

blocks.en: This section presents the annotation fields and detailed statistics of the three subsets in Sora100K: Text-to-Video Generation, Single-Turn Video Editing, and Multi-Turn Video Editing. We first describe the fields provided for each subset and then report their composition, semantic categories, editing categories, video attributes, prompt lengths, and editing chain lengths.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍"索拉100K"中三个子集的注释字段和详细统计:文本到视频生成,单调视频编辑,多调视频编辑. 我们首先描述为每个子集提供的字段,然后报告它们的构成,语义分类,编辑分类,视频属性,即时长度,以及编辑链长.

blocks.en: Table 5 summarizes the fields provided for the three subsets of Sora100K. The Text-to-Video Generation subset records the original prompt, supplementary description, video attributes, and semantic category. The Single-Turn Video Editing subset records each source–instruction–target transition together with its editing labels and video statistics. The Multi-Turn Video Editing subset further organizes successive video states into editing chains and records the length of each chain.
blocks.zh: 表5概述了为Sora100K三个子集提供的栏目。 Text-to-Video Generation子集记录了原始的即时,补充描述,视频属性,和语义类. 单调视频编辑子集记录每个源 - 指令 - 目标转换及其编辑标签和视频统计. 多透视视频编辑子集进一步将相继的视频状态组织入编辑链,并记录每个链的长度.

blocks.en: Annotation Fields
blocks.zh: 注释字段

blocks.en:
Text-to-Video Generation Subset. Each sample in the Text-to-Video Generation subset contains seven fields. The sample_id field provides a unique sample identifier, while prompt stores the original generation
prompt. The description_qwen field contains a supplementary video description generated by Qwen2.5-VL. The video attributes are recorded by duration_sec , frame_count , and scene_count , which represent the video duration in seconds, the number of frames, and the number of scenes or shots, respectively. The category field stores the generation category label of the sample.
blocks.zh:
文本到视频生成子集. 文本到视频生成子集中的每个样本包含7个字段. 样本_ id 字段提供了一个独特的样本标识符,同时快速存储原始生成
快点 描述_克文场包含由Quen2.5-VL生成的补充视频描述. 视频属性按持续时间_sec,帧_计数,场景_计数分别表示视频持续时间以秒,帧数,场景或镜头数. 类别字段存储样本的生成类标签.

blocks.en: Single-Turn Video Editing Subset. Each sample in the Single-Turn Video Editing subset represents one editing transition. The sample_id field identifies the sample, while source_video_id and edited_video_id identify the source and edited videos, respectively. The edit_instruction field stores the original editing instruction. The edit_labels field records the corresponding editing category labels, such as object modification and style transfer. The subset also records the video duration, frame count, and scene or shot count of each sample.
blocks.zh: 单调视频编辑子集. 单调视频编辑子集中的每个样本代表一个编辑过渡. 样本_id字段识别出样本,而 source_video_id和eded_video_id分别识别出来源和编辑的视频. 编辑_指令字段存储原始编辑指令. 编辑_标签字段记录相应的编辑类标签,如对象修改和样式转移等. 该子集还记录每个样本的视频持续时间,帧数,以及场景或镜头数.

blocks.en: Multi-Turn Video Editing Subset. The Multi-Turn Video Editing subset organizes successively edited videos into ordered editing chains. Each chain is identified by the folder_name field. The chain_length field records the number of videos contained in the chain.
blocks.zh: 多透视视频编辑子集. 多透视视频编辑子集将相继被编辑的视频组织成有秩序的编辑链. 每个链由文件夹_名字段识别. 链_长字段记录了链中包含的视频数量.

blocks.en: Overall Dataset Composition
blocks.zh: 总体数据集构成

blocks.en: Sora100K contains 103,439 entries across its three subsets. The Text-to-Video Generation subset contains 18,451 entries and accounts for 17.8% of the dataset. The Single-Turn Video Editing subset contains 76,964 entries, representing the largest proportion at 74.4%. The remaining 8,024 entries belong to the Multi-Turn Video Editing subset, accounting for 7.8%.
blocks.zh: Sora100K包含103,439个条目,横跨其三个子集. 文本到视频生成子集包含18,451个条目,占数据集的17.8%. 单调视频编辑子集包含76,964个条目,比例最大的是74.4%. 其余8,024个条目属于多透视视频编辑子集,占7.8%.

blocks.en: Text-to-Video Generation Statistics
blocks.zh: 文本到视频生成统计

blocks.en: Semantic Category Distribution. The semantic distribution of the Text-to-Video Generation subset is dominated by people-related content. The People category accounts for 76.85% of the subset, followed by Animal at 13.11%. Transportation and Scenery account for 2.77% and 2.42%, respectively. The remaining categories are grouped as Other , which accounts for 4.85%.
blocks.zh: 语义类发行. 文本到视频世代子集的语义分布以与人相关的内容为主. 人类占子类的76.85%,其次是动物类的13.11%. 运输和文艺分别占2.77%和2.42%。 其余类别归入其他类别,占4.85%。

blocks.en: Prompt Length Distribution. Generation prompts are divided into five length ranges. Prompts containing no more than 10 words account for 52.20% of thesubset. Prompts containing 11–25 words account for 16.55%, while those containing 26–50 and 51–100 words account for 10.28% and 10.65%, respectively. Prompts longer than 100 words account for the remaining 10.32%.
blocks.zh: 快速长度分布 。 生成提示分为5个长度范围. 包含不超过10个字的提示占子集的52.20%. 包含11至25个字的提示占16.55%,而包含26至50个字和51至100个字的提示分别占10.28%和10.65%。 超过100个字的提示占其余的10.32%。

blocks.en: Video Duration. Most videos have durations close to 10 seconds. Videos lasting between 9.5 and 10.5 seconds account for 73.48% of the dataset, while videos lasting between 10.5 and 15 seconds account for 23.84%. Videos no longer than 9.5 seconds account for 2.57%, and only 0.11% are longer than 15 seconds.
blocks.zh: 视频持续时间。 大多数视频的长度接近10秒. 持续9.5至10.5秒的视频占数据集的73.48%,而持续10.5至15秒的视频占23.84%. 视频不超过9.5秒占2.57%,只有0.11%的视频超过15秒.

blocks.en: Scene Count. The scene-count distribution is reported over five ranges: 0, 1–3, 4–6, 7–10, and more than 10. Videos containing 4–6 or 7–10 scenes constitute the largest groups, while videos containing more than 10 scenes account for the smallest proportion.
blocks.zh: 场景伯爵. 现场统计分布在5个范围内:0,1–3,4–6,7–10,和10个以上. 包含4–6或7–10场景的视频构成最大的组别,而包含10多场景的视频占比最小.

blocks.en: Single-Turn Video Editing Statistics
blocks.zh: 单调视频编辑统计

blocks.en: The Single-Turn Video Editing subset covers five major groups of editing operations. Object-level editing accounts for the largest proportion at 52%, followed by style-level editing at 27%. Scene-level editing accounts for 9%, while narrative and temporal editing accounts for 5%. The remaining 7% is categorized as Other .
blocks.zh: 单调视频 编辑子集涵盖编辑业务的五大组. 对象级编辑占最大比例为52%,其次是风格级编辑占27%. 场景级编辑占9%,而叙事和时事编辑占5%. 其余7%被列为其他类别。

blocks.en: Object-Level Editing. Object-level editing modifies visible entities or their attributes within a video. This group accounts for 52% of the Single-Turn Video Editing subset.
blocks.zh: 对象级编辑 。 对象级编辑在视频中修改可见实体或其属性. 这个组占了单调视频编辑子集的52%.

blocks.en: Style-Level Editing. Style-level editing changes the visual appearance or presentation style of a video. This group accounts for 27% of the subset.
blocks.zh: 样式级编辑。 样式级编辑会改变视频的视觉外观或展示风格. 这个组占子集的27%.

blocks.en: Scene-Level Editing. Scene-level editing changes the scene or environmental content of a video. This group accounts for 9% of the subset.
blocks.zh: 场景级编辑. 场景级编辑会改变视频的场景或环境内容. 此组占子集的9%.

blocks.en: Narrative and Temporal Editing. Narrative and temporal editing changes the narrative content or temporal development of a video. This group accounts for 5% of the subset.
blocks.zh: 叙述和临时编辑。 叙述和时间编辑改变了视频的叙述内容或时间发展. 此组占子集的5%.

blocks.en: Multi-Turn Video Editing Statistics
blocks.zh: 多回合视频编辑统计

blocks.en: The Multi-Turn Video Editing subset contains ordered video chains formed through successive editing operations. We use chain length, defined as the number of videos contained in an editing chain, to describe the structural distribution.
blocks.zh: 多盘视频 编辑子集包含了通过相继编辑操作而形成的有秩序的视频链. 我们使用链长,定义为编辑链中包含的视频数量来描述结构分布.

blocks.en: Appendix E Experiment
blocks.zh: 附录E 实验

blocks.en: Experiment Setting
blocks.zh: 实验设置

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. For the text-to-video generation experiment, we randomly sample 3,000 videos from the Text-to-Video Generation subset and adapt the base LTX-2 model using LoRA. Each training sample retains its audio input and is resized to a resolution of 512 × 768 512\times 768 with 121 frames. We train the model for five epochs using a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . The LoRA rank is set to 32, and LoRA adapters are applied to the to_k , to_q , to_v , and to_out.0 modules. Gradient checkpointing is enabled to reduce GPU memory consumption. The experiment is conducted on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, with approximately 40 GB of peak GPU memory usage. The detailed configuration is summarized in Table 6 .
We follow the official LTX-2 training workflow and divide the adaptation process into data preprocessing and LoRA fine-tuning. For the video editing experiments, we randomly sample 3,000 samples from the Single-Turn Video Editing subset and fine-tune LTX-2-T2AV-IC. Each training sample contains the edited video, input audio, and an in-context source video, together with the frame rate and context-downsampling information. All videos are resized to 512 × 768 512\times 768 and represented by 81 frames.
During preprocessing, we load the text-encoder post-processing modules, video VAE encoder, audio VAE encoder, and Gemma-3-12B weights to precompute the training representations. We then fine-tune the DiT transformer for five epochs using a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . LoRA is applied to the to_k , to_q , to_v , and to_out.0 modules with a rank of 32. Gradient checkpointing is enabled throughout training. All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, with approximately 40 GB of peak GPU memory usage. The detailed configuration is summarized in Table 6 .

我们遵循LTX-2的正式培训工作流程,并将适应过程分为数据预处理和LORA微调. 对于视频编辑实验,我们随机抽取了从单调视频编辑子集中的3000个样本并微调了LTX-2-T2AV-IC. 每个培训样本都包含经编辑的视频,输入音频,以及一个内文源视频,以及帧率和上下文样本信息. 所有视频被调整为512×768 512\times 768,并以81帧为代表.

blocks.en: Experiment Result.
blocks.zh: 实验结果。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 14 – Figure 17 , we provide additional qualitative results of multi-turn video creation trajectories.
blocks.zh: 如图所示 14 — 图17, 我们提供了多回合视频创作轨迹的额外质量结果.

blocks.en: Figure 14: Qualitative comparison between the Sora100K-adapted model and LTX-2 on text-to-video generation. Each example presents sampled frames from the two models under the same prompt, illustrating their differences in visual quality, subject preservation, and consistency across shots. Red boxes highlight representative subject-consistency differences.
blocks.zh: 图14:"索拉100K"改编模型与"文字到视频生成"上的LTX-2的定性比较. 每个例子都在同一快取下从两个模型中取出样本框架,说明它们在视觉质量、主题保存和各镜头的一致性等方面的差异。 红箱突出代表性主题-一致性差异.

blocks.en: Figure 15: Qualitative comparison between the Sora100K-adapted model and LTX-2 on single-turn video editing. The examples cover object removal and merging, lighting-effect addition, and watermark insertion.
blocks.zh: 图15:"Sora100K"改编型号和"LTX-2"在单回合视频编辑上的定性比较. 这些例子包括物体去除和合并、增加照明效果和插入水印等。

blocks.en: Figure 16: Qualitative comparison of multi-turn video editing between LTX-2 and our model. The models sequentially modify the source video according to four editing instructions. Our model better preserves character appearance and scene structure while accumulating changes across turns.
blocks.zh: 图 16:LTX-2与我们模式的多回合视频编辑定性比较. 模型按照四个编辑指令相继修改了源视频. 我们的模型更好地保存了人物外观和场景结构,同时积累了跨转弯的变化.

blocks.en: Figure 17: Qualitative comparison of multi-turn video editing between LTX-2 and our model. Starting from the same source video, the models sequentially apply a high-motion anime style and add a halo to the character. Our model better preserves the visual content and previous editing effects across successive turns.
blocks.zh: 图17 LTX-2与我们模式的多回合视频编辑定性比较. 从同源视频开始,模型相继应用了高调动画风格并给角色添加光环. 我们的模型更好地保存视觉内容 和之前的编辑效果 跨相继的转弯。
